service.description: Stores, each part once (a repository with commits already is left as it is): - iron: the repository iron (database) of IRON: five commits on main by joe.developer and john.doe naming IRON-2, IRON-5 and IRON-3, the tag IRON/v0.1, a rule protecting main from force pushes and deletes; the branch IRON-3-expand-collapse with two commits and an open merge request of it by joe.developer (Closes IRON-3, john.doe asked to review, without a notification, and a review thread on a line of src/tree.js: john's question and joe's answer); the branch IRON-7-timer with one commit by bob.developer; ci/build passed on main and on the merge request's head, failed on IRON-7-timer. - acme: the repository acme-portal (database) of ACME: two commits by joe.developer naming ACME-1 and ACME-3, the tag ACME/v0.1. In iron's history before IRON-3 (P4b), IRON's documentation space in the repository at docs/ (mantle.work.ProjectServices create#ProjectDocsSpace, impl-projects.md F7) with Getting started and Architecture, and the page Build setup of the Engineering notes space linked to IRON; when it fails it is logged and the rest of the part goes on. No commit message holds a Fixes keyword, so no demo work item changes status. A part that fails is logged by name and the others are still loaded.
One part of load#CodeDemo: repositories (iron and acme-portal made and linked), iron or acme (their commits and the rest, when the repository has none yet).
